prompts.prompt: Box-shaped camera with a flat body and a lens extending from the front.
A compact camera with a large front lens ring.
prompts.prompt_zh: 一台紧凑相机,前面有大镜头环。

prompts.prompt: A sedan twelve studs long with a flat hood, a raked windshield into a two-seat cabin, a rear window sloping to a short trunk, and four black wheels under the body.
prompts.prompt_zh: 一辆轿车,长十二粒,引擎盖平坦,风挡倾斜通入双人座舱,后窗斜落至短行李箱,车身下有四个黑色车轮。

prompts.prompt: A sedan stretching twelve studs: long flat hoodline, angled windshield feeding the cabin, sloped rear glass to a short trunk, four dark wheels tucked under.

A detailed sedan stretching twelve studs: soft-rounded hood, center grille, paired headlights, leaning windshield, side-window roof, sweeping rear to a stubby lit trunk, mirrors out wide and notched-arch wheels below.
prompts.prompt_zh: 一辆精致的轿车,长达十二粒:柔和圆润的引擎盖,中央格栅,成对前灯,倾斜风挡,带侧窗的车顶,尾部一路延伸到短小带灯的行李箱,后视镜外伸,下面是缺口轮拱车轮。

prompts.prompt: A finished sedan built on a twelve-stud body — rounded hood, grille line, twin headlights, sharply raked windshield, smooth windowed roof, fastback glass to a low short trunk with lights, side mirrors and notched-arch wheels at each corner.
